name: google-ads-performance-report
description: Use for "how are my Google Ads doing", "why did my cost per lead go up", "which campaigns improved this month", "am I losing impression share", "what happened to my Google Ads last week", or a weekly or monthly account check — even when the user never says "review". Also use when someone wants to know what changed in the account and why, or needs the baseline read before deciding anything else. Google Ads only.
